title: The Taken Child
text: A recruit sleeping in the barracks was gone at dawn, the blankets still warm, the door still barred. A trail of black leaves leads across the yard and through the streets to the Rift Gate. The Hollow Wood has taken one of ours. Someone must go and bring them back.

options.label: Keep a vigil at the Gate for them, so they can find their way home.

outcomes.text: Candles burn at the Gate every night, and the town keeps them lit with you.

options.label: Leave the wood an offering, in case it is open to a trade.

outcomes.text: The offering is gone in the morning. Nothing else is.
The offering is gone, and a second bed is empty.

options.label: Keep it quiet. It is only a recruit.

outcomes.text: The barracks talk anyway, and so does the town.
